examples.title: To Be Alive
examples.description: A two-minute orchestral cue moving from D major toward E major, with plucked textures, a synth bed and a melodic climax.

examples.title: S01 Departure
examples.description: 01 — Departure / Everyone Gets In. Bags in the trunk, seatbelts, morning anticipation. No real beat yet — a warm sub heartbeat and dashboard clicks.

examples.title: S02 Leaving Town
examples.description: 02 — Leaving Town. Neighborhood roads, first jokes in the car, the road motif is introduced plainly. Relaxed 98 BPM groove, bouncy warm bass.

examples.title: S03 Highway Opens
examples.description: 03 — Highway Opens. The city drops behind, the car finds its rhythm. Steady 110 BPM melodic house — the first "everyone can nod along" section.

examples.title: S04 Daydream
examples.description: 04 — Window Seat Daydream. Clouds, fields, distant hills. Drums lighten; bell synths and a childlike (not childish) melody carry the section.

examples.title: S05A Road Game Pt1
examples.description: 05a — Road Game / Momentum, part I. Playful, syncopated, family energy — the "fun" section, not the "rave" section. 120 BPM nu-disco bounce.

examples.title: S05B Road Game Pt2
examples.description: 05b — Road Game / Momentum, part II. The trip becomes active again; same game continues, denser and brighter, still tasteful — not a rave.

examples.title: S06 Big View
examples.description: 06 — Big View / Mountain or Ocean Reveal. Everyone sees something beautiful outside. D major (the album's emotional lift). The road motif returns as the main theme, wide and bright but never harsh. 124 BPM.

examples.title: S07 Rest Stop
examples.description: 07 — Rest Stop / Night Air. Gas station lights, snacks, a quiet reset. No kick. Ambient, reflective — a rest, not a mystery. D major, sparse.

examples.title: S08 Golden Hour
examples.description: 08 — Golden Hour Drive. Warm light, second wind, less machine more human. Home key returns (A major). Organic-feeling percussion, warm bass, 112 BPM.

examples.title: S09 Arrival
examples.description: 09 — Arrival / One Last Look Back. Tired but happy; the trip becomes a memory. Drums strip away, the road motif returns slower and warmer, then a soft struck/synth hybrid carries it to silence. Not "the party ended" — "we shared something."
